fields.Voting system: Each country awards one set in the semi-finals, and two sets in the final, of 12, 10, 8–1 points to ten songs. In all three shows, online votes from viewers in non-participating countries are aggregated and awarded as one set of points.

rows: Hosted the Second Chance round of Melodifestivalen in 2020. Did not meet the EBU requirements of capacity.
Hosted the Eurovision Song Contest 1985. Roof needed adjustments for the lighting equipment. Set for demolition after the construction of a new sports facility nearby is completed.
Hosted the heats of Melodifestivalen in 2007. Did not meet the EBU requirements of capacity.
Hosted the heats of Melodifestivalen in 2007, 2010, 2014, 2018 and the semi-final in 2023.
Hosted Eurovision Choir 2019. Did not meet the EBU requirements of capacity.
Hosted one heat of Melodifestivalen in 2010. Plans included the cooperation of other municipalities in Gävleborg.
Hosted all but one final of Melodifestivalen since 2013. Preferred venue of the Stockholm City Council.
Proposal set around building a temporary arena in Frihamnen [ sv ], motivated by the production needs of the contest and difficulties in finding vacant venues during the required weeks.
